identified_problem: Fondul Proprietatea is Romania's largest closed-end investment fund, listed on the Bucharest and London Stock Exchanges, with a portfolio concentrated in Romanian energy, utilities and infrastructure holdings. potential_pain: Without forward-looking physical risk screening, flood or drought-driven impairments at portfolio companies can translate into NAV markdowns and concentrated drawdowns that are hard to explain to international shareholders.
